mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 3.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the unemployment rate above 4% signals weakening labor market strength, reducing investor confidence and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 4% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Concomitant growth in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) create synergistic effects, amplifying equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increasing > 2% and FEDFUNDS decreasing > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly higher than baseline when both proxies meet trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 105.0 indicates weakening supply-side momentum, dampening economic growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite INDPRO falling below 105.0 threshold.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), investors anticipate future rate hikes, reducing risk premium valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative during tightening phase (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS increasing) coupled with falling unemployment (UNRATE decreasing) signals robust employment, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increasing > 5% and UNRATE decreasing < 0.05pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly higher than baseline when both proxies meet trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Extremely low unemployment rates below 4% signal a tight labor market, driving up wage growth and corporate profits, which enhance S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive despite UNRATE remaining below 4% for 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above long-term trend levels (e.g., >105.5) reflects robust supply chain activity, fostering economic expansion and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite INDPRO exceeding trend.
